name: 大嗓门
description: 场上随机出现一个大嗓门；他存在时，每次抽取后空出的格子会自动填入一个抢菜人；抽到大嗓门将其移除，同时清除场上所有抢菜人；抽到抢菜人会触发人挤人
description_en: A Loudmouth appears at a random position; while present, each emptied cell refills with a Competitor; draw the Loudmouth to remove it and clear all Competitors; drawing a Competitor triggers a doom resolution
